title: BioCarb harmonized LCA-TEA model, inventory and results (v1.1.0)
description: Python model, life-cycle inventory, techno-economic parameters, results and figures for the manuscript 'Carbon-storing recycled concrete fines as a drop-in supplementary cementitious material: harmonized life-cycle and techno-economic assessment across deployment scales'. Licensed background unit impact scores (ecoinvent 3.7 / NETL openLCA) are not included; a schema and regeneration instructions are provided.
